exactGeometryOperation: Copy the underlying BSplineSurface then call segment(u1,u2,v1,v2). This mutates knot/pole support, unlike merely creating a trimmed face on the original surface. Existing-knot U bands address the486-pole direction; retain the full4-pole V domain. Preserve trims/orientation when reconstructing the face.
nativeFeatureLimitation: No standard parametric document feature wrapping exact surface segmentation was identified in inspected sources. Part::Spline is a base feature only; Surface::Cut performs a boolean; Surface::Extend samples/refits rather than exact segmentation. A Python shape operation cached in Part::Feature does not by itself recompute from upstream parameters and is not a substitute for the required native parametric construction.
sectorProbeFindings: The retained fan probe is not an exact partition: assemblies contain4,4,5 solids; CenterShoulder volume56283.63 vs91419.57mm3 and RoundFlat31676.62 vs90436.48mm3. Independently re-lofting normalized profile fractions can alter cross-section correspondence and interpolation; validity of each wedge is insufficient.
recommendation: If implementing an exact computational probe, segment the already-built loft surface with its own UV knots and compare degree/poles, shared-edge coincidence, area/volume and point/normal evaluations. For the deliverable under existing native-only constraints, the author must instead create and verify smaller corresponding native section/loft features; this is a revised construction, not automatically an exact representation of the old loft. Confirm single-solid union and no missing/overlapping sectors before export.
